purpose: Freeze the FL-first architecture, contracts and control plane of the faculty-demonstrable NHM federated physiological-monitoring capstone, as an additive layer above the frozen SOFTWARE_SYSTEM_V2.
science_statement: CAP-001 DOES NOT change the frozen NHM science, models, calibration, thresholds, preprocessing, alert policy, gateway, API schema, FL lineage or release evidence.

historical_facts_preserved.relationship: independent facts; neither replaces the other

protected_rule: No byte or semantic change; no in-place regeneration; additive successors only.

architecture.layering: Browser/product frontend -> CAPSTONE PRODUCT API -> device/session/stream orchestration -> existing source-to-window runtime -> internal inference client -> POST /v1/infer-window -> SOFTWARE_SYSTEM_V2 -> typed response -> product event translation -> WebSocket -> frontend
forbidden_paths: product routes on the frozen inference API
public model/candidate selector on the released runtime
architecture.frontend_foundation: existing frontend/ SvelteKit app is the ONLY frontend foundation; planned additive successor CAPSTONE_UI_V1; no second frontend, no framework migration, no duplicated dashboard components, existing V2 replay integration retained

live_vs_fl.live_loop: Device -> ObservedRecord -> preprocessing/windowing -> MODEL_V2_FINAL -> CAL_V2 -> alert/state logic -> dashboard
live_vs_fl.fl_loop: distributed research clients -> local training -> updates -> aggregation / SecAgg research pathway -> research model state/evidence

fl_views.FL_ENGINEERING_DEMO: V2-FL-005 (8 virtual clients, 3 rounds, 24 canonical local updates, routing, restart/resume, SecAgg shadow)

live_vs_fl.continual_sandbox_allowed: interactive multi-round federated model-development with new simulated batches and governed candidates
live_vs_fl.candidate_deployment_path: none; a candidate can only be exercised in the isolated CAPSTONE_FL_SANDBOX_RUNTIME (later phase), never /app/monitoring

hardware.simulated_source: genuine DeviceSource implementation emitting ObservedRecord (CAP-002), never fake frontend values

phase_sequence.title: Local training buffer + federated client product adapter
Live federation orchestrator + candidate model registry
Session history + scientific ML/FL evidence experience

test_strategy.cap_001: contract tests that exercise the production contract definitions (tests/test_capstone_contracts.py, tests/test_capstone_federation_contracts.py)
test_strategy.later_phases: each connection-table edge names its own test_strategy; every phase re-runs the protected-artifact audit with zero drift

phase_acceptance_rules: method/contract freeze commit precedes result evidence
protected-artifact audit shows zero drift at entry and result
targeted tests + full existing regression + ruff + pip check pass
no later phase is started or marked PASS
any contract change after freeze is an additive successor
frontend tests/check/build run unchanged (CAP-001 modifies no frontend behavior)

framing.is: a federated physiological-monitoring platform in which local edge nodes perform live monitoring using a released model while participating, separately and under governance, in federated model-development workflows
framing.is_not: an ECG monitoring website with an FL research page

planes.contents: existing SvelteKit frontend extended additively (CAPSTONE_UI_V1): authentication, device attachment, live monitoring, session history, federation, model registry, research evidence, system/architecture, limitations
DeviceSource -> ObservedRecord -> local stream processing -> live MODEL_V2_FINAL inference -> monitoring events; separately: local training buffer -> federated local trainer -> model update
Clients 00..07 -> local training -> update submission -> FedAvg/FedProx -> SecAgg+ protected aggregation where applicable -> candidate global model state
candidate global model -> candidate registry -> engineering/validation gate -> ACCEPT or REJECT -> sandbox model version / archived candidate

historical_facts_preserved.relationship: independent facts; neither replaces the other

protected_evidence: all historical failures and negative findings

simulation_truth_boundary.may_be_consumed_by: SIMULATION_LABEL_ADAPTER_V1 only, to build LOCAL training labels in the federated sandbox
simulation_truth_boundary.enforced_by: AST import-boundary test over api/, fusion/, preprocessing/, deployment/, product/ and the live stream runtime
simulation_truth_boundary.real_label_limitation: future real-wearable data has no automatic supervised label; a separately validated label source is VERIFICATION_REQUIRED

fl_first_navigation: Federation is a top-level product section (/app/federation/*), plus /app/models; not buried under Research

canonical_representation.static vocabularies, transitions, routes: contracts/capstone/*.json (authoritative); product/ enums only name them and tests prove parity
canonical_representation.typed records (descriptor, event, edge i: pydantic models in product/ validated against the JSON vocabularies
